name: haps-interoperability
description: Port and test experimental HAPS v0.4 canonicalization and hashing across programming languages and CI systems. Not production-ready or full protocol conformance evidence.

interface.shortDescription: Port experimental HAPS hashing and test pinned vectors.
interface.longDescription: Integrate or port the HAPS v0.4 canonicalization and hashing core, expose it through a language-neutral adapter, run pinned vectors locally, and install the same gate in CI. This supports an experimental draft specification and partial reference implementation, not production-ready software. Passing does not establish full protocol conformance or that a person saw and approved the correct action.
defaultPrompt: Add the experimental HAPS interoperability tests to this project and document their limited scope.
Port experimental HAPS canonicalization to this language and document the remaining limits.
Check this HAPS adapter and install a CI gate without claiming full protocol conformance or human approval.
